method.process_scope: Inputs must describe one process lifetime on one machine monotonic clock.
method.residual: Inclusive clock interval minus union of directly linked child intervals, clipped to the parent, independently in each clock coordinate.
method.cpu_limit: CPU residual is process/thread clock consumption outside linked child time windows. It is not isolated Task CPU or a causal attribution; suspended Tasks and worker threads can contribute.
method.overlap_limit: Non-ancestral overlap is possible cross-Task activity or incomplete parent linkage. Task identity is unavailable. No wall-time fraction is used to estimate CPU.
method.aggregate_limit: Category sums can overlap across unrelated branches; use interval unions and overlap metadata. Outside-leaf coverage is unassigned to a narrow leaf phase, not necessarily uninstrumented overall.
method.missing_clock_limit: Invalid or unavailable metric intervals are reported as issues and omitted from sums, never interpreted as observed zero CPU.

markers.observer_excludes: clock sampling and async stderr writer

startup_boundary.meaning: Refresh completion is a measured boundary before READY notification; it excludes later diagnostics reading, feature queries and shutdown.

native_analysis.boundary_limit: Client launch/initialized clocks and server monotonic clocks have different origins. Duration differences are available; no invented absolute READY timestamp or proportional CPU split is used.

startup_phase_residuals.phase: Other header processing and cache residual
Probe request construction and bookkeeping residual
Project export validation and wrapper residual
SQLite cursor iteration including row decoding
Project graph and scan wrapper residual

native_analysis.overlap_limit: Root-link gaps and independent Tasks can both create unrelated branches. Category residual sums can double-count overlapping work; global wall overlap is a union, while per-category overlap is a sum.
native_analysis.runner_limit: Probe runner wall spans include server spawn/drain/reap and any work during suspension. Process/thread CPU inside them is server CPU, not child GCC CPU.
native_analysis.sql_limit: Public SQLite API spans include marshaling, worker queueing, native execution and completion. Argument arrays are a separately observed subset; native bind/step/worker CPU are not independently measured.
native_analysis.observer_limit: Compiler and server overhead markers measure different partial producer costs. They exclude some sampling, metadata, GC and asynchronous writer work, and cannot be subtracted as a production speedup.
